item.description:
Category: Ugly

Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) managed to halve its fiscal year 2026 loss to Tk 653 crore, yet its shares were downgraded to the 'Z' category. A 'Z' category classification by the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) indicates that the company is not in regular operation or has failed to comply with listing regulations, making its shares difficult to trade and highly risky for investors.

Why this matters: Despite reduced losses, the 'Z' category downgrade signifies severe non-compliance and high investment risk.
